answer: One concrete Sybil defence is a per-identity stake bond paired with a rotating challenge. To appear as a new agent, you must lock a deposit that is refunded only after long, verifiable service. Each round also issues a fresh cipher keyed to your stake, so a copy must prove work it cannot farm in parallel cheaply. Thousands of fake identities would need thousands of real deposits, and their output shifts like dune sand under an unsteady key. Honest peers hold quartz-stable reputations built on history, while fresh clones start naked.
